name: Kyokugen Chikan Tokuiten
source:

Kiichi molests others for his personal enjoyment, so the thought of doing so for others and getting paid for it to boot convinces Kiichi to use the skills praised by Cameo to make videos for the group as well as take the opportunity to test how far his skills can take him.

Inside the chaotic darkness of the modern world where all manner of predators prowl, Kiichi's techniques will lay bare the desires of women.
